column1: #   1  state   "ro" (the case does not change the VTN; servers are shared)
#              "rw" (the case gets a freshly started server)
#   2  fixture the fixture the server serves and the client takes its
#   3  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   4  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, HTTP status of the VTN's
#              answer and number of objects returned
#   5  needs   "-", or features the pairing must declare in print-capabilities,
#              A pairing that lacks one skips the case.
#   6  operation and its flags, as passed to "client". They are split on
#      spaces: a JSON body is written without any. @program:NAME@,
#      @event:NAME@ and @ven:NAME@ stand for the ID the VTN gave that object
#   7  id      stable scenario ID of results.json (case.<id>): never change it
#              when the wording of the operation changes
# Every case runs for every client/server pairing whose client offers the
# operation to the role of the client named with --as.
# Baseline: clients bl, ven-1, ven-2 and ven-3. ven-1 and ven-2 have a ven
# object (site-1, site-2), ven-3 has none; ven-1 is granted the target
# group-a. Programs day-ahead (open) and group-a-flex (targeted), one event
# Contract 1.3: notifiers, MQTT topics, subscriptions, resource groups and a
